summary: Contract fulfilled. A single dedicated preview Pages project (course-homework-preview) was created and deployed (15 files), the stable preview URL was verified serving the expected app identity/navigation, and production was kept fully separate (no production project, workflow, custom domain, or personal photos). Credential handling matches the contract: the live token is scoped to Pages Write for one account, the token and account ID exist only as GitHub Actions Secrets, the non-sensitive project name is correctly placed in a Variable, the temporary local token file was deleted, and no credential values appear in the bundle. The one historical incident — a token exposed in a browser capture during setup — was properly remediated by revoking both superseded tokens and issuing a uniquely named replacement, so there is no live secret leakage in the final state and no P0. Minor residual items: confirm deletion of the capture artifact, consider a shorter token TTL/rotation plan, and retain auditable evidence of the token scoping.
